name: Hackathon 2026
description: A 24-hour coding hackathon where teams build a working prototype around a surprise theme. Open to all departments; laptops and Wi-Fi provided.

name: Coding Competition
description: A timed competitive-programming contest covering data structures, algorithms, and problem solving. Top 3 scorers receive certificates and prizes.

name: Sports Day
description: Annual inter-department sports meet featuring athletics, cricket, and kabaddi. Registration open for both individual and team events.

name: Career Guidance Seminar
description: Industry professionals share advice on resumes, interviews, and career paths in software and core engineering roles.

name: Cultural Festival
description: A day of music, dance, and drama performances by students, closing with a prize distribution for the best acts.

name: Cybersecurity Workshop
description: Hands-on session covering network scanning, common web vulnerabilities, and safe practices, led by the CSE faculty.

name: Debate Competition
description: Teams argue for and against current-affairs topics in front of a panel of judges from the languages department.

name: Alumni Meet
description: Graduates return to share their career journeys and network with current students over informal sessions.
